hotel.footer_tagline:
Recognition without surveillance.
The difference between luxury amenities and luxury intelligence.

guest.name: Michael
guest.hero_tagline:
Ninety playlists. One discipline. Zero half-measures.
We built your stay the same way.

paragraphs.text: Not everyone gives INZO his own playlist. Not everyone tracks sweetHz and Ookean months before anyone else catches on. And not everyone names a playlist "Country-ish" — with the exact wink that says I'm curious, not committed.

You organize your world through sound — 90 playlists, each one deliberate. "Bæsic Vibes" isn't basic at all. "Pirate EDM" has its own flag. "Space Vibes" has its own orbit. And when the day is done, "Bedtime Stories" tells us you have a wind-down ritual you don't skip.

That same intentionality shows up on the mat. MMA isn't a hobby — it's a practice that demands the same strategic thinking you bring to a 4-hour playlist deep-dive. You balance the intensity of rolling bass lines and sparring rounds with the stillness of an ambient soundscape and a history podcast about fallen civilizations.

We've tried to match that range. Your mornings have fuel and movement. Your room has recovery gear, not just a minibar. Your evenings have vinyl DJs and mountain air. And your nights have the kind of deep sub-bass cocoon that makes a fireplace suite feel like the inside of a dub track.

note.closing:
This isn't a standard stay.
It's curated — the way you'd do it.

soundtrack.description: We fed your sonic fingerprint into a composer — the dub warmth of Dubby Dub Dub, the atmospheric drift of Space Vibes, the rolling energy of Mid Temp D&B. What came back is 60 seconds of ambient bass that sounds like arriving somewhere that already knows you.

experiences.description: You move between intensity and stillness with intention. So does this lineup.

items.title: DJ Nights @ Madera Bar
items.description: DJs spinning vinyl on the terrace — not a Spotify algorithm, actual records. For someone who follows 66 artists and only 25 follow back, you'll appreciate the curation. Think "Bæsic Vibes" with a cocktail and mountain air.

items.title: Falconry Experience
items.description: A centuries-old discipline built on patience, precision, and the bond between human and raptor. Someone who listens to "Fall of the Aztecs" and practices a martial art will understand what this is really about — mastery passed down through time.

items.title: Cycling Concierge
items.description: Electric bikes through the Santa Cruz Mountain foothills. Our concierge can map routes from recovery-pace to race-pace — because "Mid Temp" doesn't just describe your drum & bass, it describes your off-day cardio.

items.title: Afternoon Tea at The Library
items.description: Flamingo Estate's seasonal teas and house-made pastries in a quiet, narrative-framed space. Your "Good Reads" and "Bedtime Stories" playlists tell us you already have a ritual like this — this is the Rosewood version.

items.title: Madera Restaurant
items.description: Terrace table reserved, mountain-view side. Farm-to-table Northern California cuisine with the same attention to sourcing you bring to finding artists nobody's heard of yet. Start with the seasonal tasting menu — it rewards the kind of patience that builds 90 playlists.

items.title: Bici Coffee
items.description: Pre-training fuel. Thoughtfully sourced beans, hyper-seasonal pastries, and the kind of craft that would earn its own playlist if coffee had a BPM. We know you're up early.

items.title: Madera Bar — Your Cocktail
items.description: Our bartender is preparing a bespoke seasonal cocktail — chosen with the same intentionality you bring to naming a playlist "Bæsic Vibes" with a deliberate æ. Ask for "The Curator."

wellness.description: We framed this as recovery work, not pampering — because language matters when you've built a discipline around the mat.

items.title: Movement Studio
items.description: Mat space, bodyweight training, and stretching zones at Asaya Spa. Your practice doesn't pause for travel — and neither does your access to proper training space.

items.title: Deep Tissue Recovery
items.description: Sports-focused massage at Asaya Spa, pre-scheduled. Not a spa day — recovery work. The same way "Bedtime Stories" isn't entertainment, it's a ritual.

items.title: Pool & Terrace
items.description: Post-session cooldown with Santa Cruz Mountain views. Queue up "Space Vibes" on the terrace speaker and let the last light do its thing.

items.title: In-Room Recovery Kit
items.description: Foam roller, resistance band, electrolyte water, high-protein snacks. Standard minibar replaced with what you'd actually reach for after training.

items.label: 🔊 Arrival Soundtrack
items.description: Earthbound, Ookean, and Levity already playing on the in-room Sonos as you walk in. "Space Vibes" energy — warm pads, soft sub-bass, room to breathe.

items.label: 🌙 Turndown Music
items.description: Switches to a low ambient narrative soundscape at turndown — matching the "Bedtime Stories" vibe. Misted Minds and Unconscious Mind territory. Lights dim, fireplace lit.

items.label: 📚 Nightstand
items.description: A curated history book on ancient civilizations — connecting your "Fall of the Aztecs" curiosity to Madera's own Western exploration spirit. Not a generic coffee table book. A real read.

items.label: 🔥 Fireplace & Terrace
items.description: Your suite's private terrace faces the Santa Cruz Mountains. Fireplace set for evening listening sessions. This is where "Dubby Dub Dub" was meant to be heard — deep bass, open sky, warm air.

concierge.description: From a 5am cycling route to a midnight playlist swap to a post-training ice bath — whatever you need, whenever you need it.
